create_algorithm_jwt: create a JWT algorithm object from a string name like ES256 or RS256
build_jwt_public_keys: build a list of PEM-formatted public keys from a JWK URL and additional PEM strings
fetch_jwt_public_key_json: fetch the JWT public key JSON payload from a remote URL with optional timeout
validate_jwt_token: validate a JWT token against a dataset identifier using public keys and algorithm
parse_jwt_public_key_pem: parse and validate a PEM-formatted public key string for JWT algorithm compatibility
